schemes.ministry: Department of Social Justice & Empowerment, Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
schemes.benefits: District/State-level projects for socio-economic betterment of SCs, including comprehensive livelihood projects, skill development, related infrastructure and eligible livelihood-generation support.
schemes.application_method: Implemented through approved State/UT/District projects; beneficiary access depends on the local approved project and implementing agency.
schemes.source_title: Pradhan Mantri Anusuchit Jaati Abhyuday Yojna (PM-AJAY)
schemes.notes: Treat as program/project relevance, not as a direct individual entitlement.

schemes.scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Dakshta Aur Kushalta Sampann Hitgrahi (PM-DAKSH)
schemes.ministry: Department of Social Justice & Empowerment, Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
schemes.benefits: Skill training through short-term courses and other eligible training categories with a focus on wage/self-employment.
schemes.application_method: Register through Skill India Digital Hub (SIDH) and complete the applicable identity/category checks.
schemes.notes: SC applicants require a valid caste certificate; current official information states no income limit for SC applicants.

schemes.scheme_name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)
schemes.benefits: Market-linked skill development and placement-oriented support for eligible rural youth.
schemes.application_method: Access through DDU-GKY / State Rural Livelihood Mission implementation and approved training partners.
schemes.notes: Scheme focus is rural youth aged 15-35 from poor families; exact household eligibility must be verified through the implementation channel.

schemes.ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises
target_groups: Artisans and craftspeople in 18 notified traditional trades
schemes.benefits: Recognition, skill upgradation, toolkit incentive, concessional collateral-free credit and marketing/digital support, subject to scheme conditions.
schemes.application_method: Enrollment through the official PM Vishwakarma process / nearest Common Service Centre (CSC).
schemes.notes: Trade/family/registration conditions must be verified during official enrollment.

schemes.ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises / KVIC
schemes.benefits: Credit-linked margin-money subsidy for eligible new enterprises; subsidy rates vary by category and rural/urban location.
schemes.application_method: Apply through the official PMEGP e-portal subject to project, education and prior-subsidy conditions.
schemes.notes: Education requirement depends on project cost; existing/subsidized units may be excluded under scheme rules.
